scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -k -n CLIENT,SERVER -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.dev:client: npm run build -w shared && npm run dev -w client
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w shared && npm run dev -w server
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
